title: QA and captures read isolated sites through the configured public proxy without acquiring site networks
steps: Make every direct site road unreachable and read two site names through one configured proxy backend.
Try a wrong or absent site routing receipt, an external/control-plane redirect, a direct HTTP500 and cancellation during a pending HEAD request.
expect: Host/protocol and site identity remain exact for concurrent sites; the CMS cannot forge the proxy routing receipt.
A direct HTTP error is measured without proxy fallback; each proxied navigation requires the same site receipt; a backend redirect is never site evidence.
Aborting a pending probe closes the request and response bytes are not retained.
A proxy transport failure aborts QA and capture navigation without an unchecked direct retry.
evidence: Joomla Retry provisioned successfully but baseline could not open its private-network DNS from tracy-host; anonymous host-to-web proxy read returns the Joomla document while unknown label returns404.
fence: The proxy origin comes only from validated TRACY_WEB_ORIGIN, not the request or site; no seat credential or network attachment is added.

tests: isolated sites use the configured proxy with their own Host and require its routing receipt
a direct HTTP 500 remains the measured road instead of being hidden by a healthy proxy
each proxied navigation requires the same site receipt and disposes failed responses
cancelling a proxy probe while headers are pending closes its HTTP request
capture and QA abort a failed proxy navigation without trying the public address directly
